parts.text:
深度验证暴露了问题：**66 个里只有 17 个真能看到活**。20 个看不到，15 个 404。这说明“首页能打开”不等于“有活”。

我再补一批**垂直类散活平台**（设计、写作、翻译、转录、教育），这类通常活最多：

tool_input.code:
const fs = await import('node:fs/promises');
const S = "D:\\GitHub\\My-second-brain\\50-知识\\AI工具\\_scripts";

const vertical = [
  // 设计类（活最多的一类）
  ["99designs","99designs.com","https://99designs.com/designers/browse","设计比赛"],
  ["DesignCrowd","designcrowd.com","https://www.designcrowd.com/projects","设计比赛"],
  ["Designhill","designhill.com","https://www.designhill.com/contest","设计比赛"],
  ["crowdSPRING","crowdspring.com","https://www.crowdspring.com/projects/","设计比赛"],
  ["Hatchwise","hatchwise.com","https://www.hatchwise.com/contest","设计比赛"],
  // 写作类
  ["Textbroker","textbroker.com","https://www.textbroker.com/","写作"],
  ["iWriter","iwriter.com","https://www.iwriter.com/","写作"],
  ["WriterAccess","writeraccess.com","https://www.writeraccess.com/","写作"],
  ["Constant Content","constant-content.com","https://www.constant-content.com/","写作"],
  ["Content Gather","contentgather.com","https://www.contentgather.com/","写作"],
  // 翻译类
  ["Gengo","gengo.com","https://gengo.com/translators/","翻译"],
  ["Unbabel","unbabel.com","https://unbabel.com/editors/","翻译"],
  ["ProZ","proz.com","https://www.proz.com/","翻译"],
  ["Smartcat","smartcat.com","https://www.smartcat.com/","翻译"],
  ["TranslatorsCafe","translatorscafe.com","https://www.translatorscafe.com/","翻译"],
  // 转录类
  ["Rev","rev.com","https://www.rev.com/freelancers","转录"],
  ["TranscribeMe","transcribeme.com","https://www.transcribeme.com/","转录"],
  ["GoTranscript","gotranscript.com","https://gotranscript.com/","转录"],
  ["Scribie","scribie.com","https://scribie.com/","转录"],
  ["CastingWords","castingwords.com","https://castingwords.com/","转录"],
  // 教育辅导类
  ["Chegg","chegg.com","https://www.chegg.com/tutors/","家教"],
  ["Studypool","studypool.com","https://www.studypool.com/","家教"],
  ["Wyzant","wyzant.com","https://www.wyzant.com/tutors/","家教"],
  ["Preply","preply.com","https://preply.com/en/teach","语言家教"],
  ["italki","italki.com","https://www.italki.com/teach","语言家教"],
  ["Cambly","cambly.com","https://www.cambly.com/english?lang=en","语言家教"],
  // 更多微任务/测试
  ["Prolific","prolific.com","https://www.prolific.com/","调研"],
  ["Userlytics","userlytics.com","https://www.userlytics.com/","UX测试"],
  ["TestingTime","testingtime.com","https://www.testingtime.com/en/","调研"],
  ["PicoWorkers","picoworkers.com","https://picoworkers.com/","微任务"],
  ["Swagbucks","swagbucks.com","https://www.swagbucks.com/","微任务"],
  ["PrizeRebel","prizerebel.com","https://www.prizerebel.com/","微任务"],
  // 更多赏金
  ["Synack","synack.com","https://www.synack.com/","漏洞赏金"],
  ["Cobalt","cobalt.io","https://www.cobalt.io/","漏洞赏金"],
  ["Zerocopter","zerocopter.com","https://www.zerocopter.com/","漏洞赏金"],
  ["HackenProof","hackenproof.com","https://hackenproof.com/","漏洞赏金"],
  ["Openbugbounty2","openbugbounty.org","https://www.openbugbounty.org/","漏洞赏金"],
  // 更多综合接单
  ["FreelancerIndia","freelancer.in","https://www.freelancer.in/jobs/","接单"],
  ["WorkNHire","worknhire.com","https://www.worknhire.com/","接单"],
  ["Truelancer2","truelancer.com","https://www.truelancer.com/freelance-jobs","接单"],
  ["Upwork","upwork.com","https://www.upwork.com/nx/search/jobs/","接单"],
  ["PeoplePerHour","peopleperhour.com","https://www.peopleperhour.com/freelance-jobs","接单"],
];
await fs.writeFile(S+"\\_GIG_VERTICAL.json", JSON.stringify(vertical.map(v=>({name:v[0],host:v[1],url:v[2],type:v[3]})),null,1), "utf8");
return { count: vertical.length };
